text: The screenshots went viral. And no, he never got the car. The dealer pulled the bot.
Two months later, in Canada, it stopped being funny.
Air Canada's chatbot gave a grieving customer the wrong refund rules.
The airline argued the chatbot was responsible for its own words.
The tribunal said no. Air Canada had to pay.
The lesson: if an AI talks on your website, it talks for your business.
